d=

H =
    normalize(V + L);

F =
    FresnelSchlick(
        max(dot(H, V), 0.0),
        F0);

D =
    DistributionGGX(
        N,
        H,
        roughness);

G =
    GeometrySchlickGGX(
        NdotV,
        roughness)
    *
    GeometrySchlickGGX(
        NdotL,
        roughness);

specular =
    D * G * F /
    max(
        4.0 *
        NdotV *
        NdotL,
        epsilon);

kD =
    (1.0 - F) *
    (1.0 - metallic);

BRDF =
    kD *
    baseColor / PI
    +
    specular;

Lo +=
    BRDF *
    radiance *
    NdotL *
    visibility;
